## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] Tests and local gates pass (backend: `make lint`, `make type-check`, `make test`; frontend: `npm run lint`, `npm run type-check`, `npm test`)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for changed behaviour
- [ ] Docs are updated (README, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`) where behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data or real learner data in code, logs, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] New outbound network calls, if any, are blocked when `PRIVACY_LOCAL_ONLY=true`
- [ ] OpenStax attribution is kept for new or changed content
